mapper.select: select USER_ID as userId, SYSTEM_CODE as systemCode, USER_NAME as userName, REAL_NAME as realName, MAIL_ADDR as mailAddr, PHONE_NUM as phoneNum, PASSWORD as password, SALT as salt, DEPT_CODE as deptCode, SSO_USER_ID as ssoUserId, ADMIN_FLAG as adminFlag, IS_FROZEN as isFrozen, WECHAT_NUM as wechatNum from SYS_USER where USER_NAME = #{username, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT T2.ID, T2.PLATFORM_NAME, T2.PLATFORM_HOST, T2.PLATFORM_URL as platformIndex, T2.WEIGHT, T2.ICON, T2.COOKIE_KEY, T2.DESCRIBE FROM SSO_USER_PLATFORM T1 LEFT JOIN SSO_PLATFORM T2 ON T1.PLATFORM_ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.STATUS=1 and T1.USER_ID = #{username}
SELECT ID, PLATFORM_NAME, PLATFORM_URL as platformIndex, PLATFORM_HOST, WEIGHT, ICON, COOKIE_KEY FROM SSO_PLATFORM where ID = #{id} and STATUS = '1'
